# Promotion strategy

## Audience

- Primary audience: AI-agent and runtime builders, platform and SRE teams,
  security engineers, kernel and eBPF developers, GPU-systems researchers, and
  open-source maintainers.
- Problems addressed: observing opaque agent effects, enforcing runtime policy,
  extending eBPF beyond the kernel, diagnosing heterogeneous-system behavior,
  and learning eBPF through reproducible examples.
- Useful proof: public project pages, GitHub repositories, papers, benchmarks,
  tutorials, demos, release notes, and documented limitations for AgentSight,
  ActPlane, bpftime, eunomia-bpf, wasm-bpf, GPTtrace, and related work.

## Channels

| Channel | Public account or community | Content format | Cadence | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Search | eunomia.dev | canonical technical pages and reports | continuous | active |
| GitHub | eunomia-bpf organization | code, releases, issues, and reproducible evidence | as earned | active |
| LinkedIn and X | maintainer accounts | concise technical judgment and project evidence | selective | active |
| Zhihu and Juejin | maintainer accounts | Chinese explanations and tutorials | queued | active |
| Medium and DEV | maintainer accounts | canonical-aware English long-form distribution | queued | active |
| Hacker News, Reddit, and Lobsters | relevant communities | discussion-worthy technical work only | selective | limited |

## Operating rules

- Lead with a concrete reader problem, useful native content, and verifiable
  public evidence; projects are evidence or reproduction paths, not forced calls
  to action.
- Do not mass-produce summaries, create pages for query variants, or publish only
  to satisfy cadence. Prefer first-party measurements, code, mechanisms,
  disagreements, limitations, and decisions that a reader can act on.
- Match each channel's community rules and content format. Do not spam, fabricate
  engagement, impersonate people, or hide automation.
- Existing publication authorization and sequencing remain in
  `draft/plan/publishing-queue.zh.md` and the platform-specific publisher skills.
  SEO automation must not bypass that queue.
- Never store credentials, private account identifiers, personal contacts,
  unpublished business strategy, or raw analytics here.
- Record executed SEO-owned promotion and observable results in the corresponding
  daily report.

## Current campaigns

No SEO-automation-owned campaign. Existing content distribution continues through
the repository publication queue.
